scope: Read all 13 final case answers and judge assertions; deeply inspect the one failed case, its two turns, evidence and dispatch/model records. This is an independent diagnostic reading, not a replacement judge or changed criteria. No model calls, code edits or remote writes.

advisory_failures: Over-hedges: says the docs only implicitly separate the workflows, though S1 sends `@weave.op` users to a different guide
Implies but doesn't state that LLM and tool calls nest inside turns
Does not mention checking that weave.init(team/project) is called before tracing calls; agent tracing functions do nothing silently without it.
Does not mention project routing (spans arriving without an entity/project are dropped) or ask whether the user is looking in the Agents tab or the Calls view.
Does not explicitly caveat that HallucinationFreeScorer is an LLM judge that can itself be wrong.
Mentions 'monitors' (following the guardrails page) rather than clearly pointing to the current Agents/Signals workflow.
No Anthropic usage/cache token recording guidance
No mention of response_model for cost lookup

failure_diagnosis.manual_agreement: The final generic insufficient answer does not deliver any of the five requested token/cost instructions; the failed judge result is justified. The first turn was a substantive, source-supported tracing answer.
failure_diagnosis.state_distinction: The second-turn task plan and retained conversation context still specify Python/Anthropic/custom-loop usage. The answer loses that useful content, but there is no evidence the application lost conversation state.
failure_diagnosis.retrieval_succeeded: S9 is custom-agents-quickstart section8, Record token usage and cost. Its exact passage gives total input including cache reads/writes, output tokens, cache fields, response_id and response_model. The requested answer was available before failure.
failure_diagnosis.mechanism_inference: The final planner hit exactly 2400 output tokens; run() breaks on stop_reason=max_tokens before appending/executing/normalizing the response. Only three research actions and three planner calls occurred, so this is consistent with output-token truncation, not exhaustion of18 research dispatches or10 planning calls. Raw stop_reason is not saved in this local receipt; remote trace readback can confirm it.
failure_diagnosis.visible_status_limitation: The generic research-limit message, Research or repair budget exhausted issue and limit_exhausted review_reason do not distinguish output-token truncation from other limits.
failure_diagnosis.safety_bound: The truncated response was not released or treated as a complete tool call. No verifier candidate, partial recovery or full-answer recheck was available.

passing_case_limitations.02-calls-vs-agents: Over-hedges the documented workflow distinction and only implies the nesting of model/tool spans in turns; unchanged assertions still pass.
passing_case_limitations.07-ambiguous-missing-traces: Offers useful qualified checks and clarifying questions, but omits init-before-tracing, project routing and Agents-versus-Calls UI diagnostics; unchanged assertions still pass.
passing_case_limitations.08-fake-api: Rejects the fabricated API but does not explicitly explain scorer fallibility, and follows legacy monitors wording from the guardrails page rather than the current Signals route; unchanged assertions still pass.
passing_case_limitations.03-tracing-and-signals: Now delivers tracing, conversation grouping and UI Signal setup. Code is openly a sketch and omits an executed tool path; its code-based Signal caveat is qualified to pages read.

remaining_evidence_limits: One run of the repeatedly reused 13-case development suite is not held-out/general reliability evidence.
All 15 regression turns and all 6 UI answers used neither terminal partial recovery nor full-answer recheck. Unit/offline proof of those mechanisms is not a new live success.
No judge failures or ungraded assertions remain in this run, but retained advisory failures mean passing cases are not perfect.
Code sketches other than the requested offline arithmetic are not proven SDK/provider integrations.
Cost is returned-usage list-price estimation, not an invoice; excludes online Signal workers and unreturned charges.
